note: Ploomber (YC W22, founded 2022 by Eduardo Blancas and Ido Michael) started as an open-source Python pipeline/notebook tool and later launched Ploomber Cloud, a hosted app-deployment PaaS. Per the company's own blog post ('Ploomber's app hosting platform is shutting down', Sep 2025) and Wayback evidence, Ploomber Cloud was retired on 2025-10-31; deploys stopped 2025-10-03. ploomber.io now has no A records and YC lists the company as Inactive. The YC directory listing's website (https://ploomber.io/) matches the card's domain, confirming this is the same company. No funding amount beyond the YC accelerator investment could be confirmed within the research time budget; not a priceable/active provider.
